topic: Gieo mầm cho đời sau — cho đi mà không chờ nhận lại

cast.look: An old white stick-figure man with a smooth bald oval head, a short white beard, two tiny black dot eyes and a calm patient expression, wearing a simple brown vest over a white shirt and loose grey trousers rolled up to the knee, thin black stick arms and legs.

A young white stick-figure man with a plain oval head, short tidy black hair, two tiny black dot eyes and a faint confident smirk, wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, thin black stick arms and legs.

The same man now old: a white stick-figure man with a bald oval head, a short grey beard, slightly stooped shoulders, wearing a faded blue shirt and dark trousers, leaning on a simple wooden walking cane.
A small white stick-figure child with a round head, two short black pigtails, two tiny black dot eyes and a curious open smile, wearing a plain yellow shirt and short trousers.

lines: Có một ông lão đào hố bên vệ đường đất, dưới cái nắng tháng sáu.
scenes.image: He is digging a small hole with a worn shovel beside a dusty dirt road under a harsh summer sun, dry yellow fields stretching to the horizon, heat haze in the distance.

lines: Ông trồng cây con, một hàng dài ven đường.
Cây nào cũng cách nhau đúng mười bước chân.
scenes.image: He is planting a row of thin young saplings evenly spaced along the edge of the long dirt road, each one a fragile stick with a few leaves, the row disappearing into the distance.

lines: Một chàng trai đi ngang qua, dừng lại nhìn, rồi bật cười.
scenes.image: A young man walking along the road has stopped and is laughing openly, pointing at the old man kneeling in the dirt beside a tiny sapling.

lines: "Cụ ơi, cụ bảy mươi rồi. Cây này ba chục năm nữa mới có bóng mát."
"Cụ có ngồi dưới nó được đâu."
scenes.image: Close view of the young man talking down at the kneeling old man, a speech bubble above him showing a small sapling with a red cross beside a stick figure sitting in shade.

lines: Ông cúi xuống, lấp đất quanh gốc cây, rồi tưới nước.
scenes.image: The old man, saying nothing, is gently patting soil around the base of a sapling and pouring water from a battered tin watering can, his face calm and unbothered.

lines: Chàng trai lắc đầu bỏ đi. Anh nghĩ ông lão lẩm cẩm.
scenes.image: The young man walks away down the road with his back to the viewer, shaking his head, while the small kneeling figure of the old man grows distant behind him.

lines: Con đường đất ngày ấy giờ rợp bóng cây.
scenes.image: The same road forty years later, now a wide green tunnel of tall leafy trees arching overhead, dappled sunlight falling on the path, cool and shaded, no people in sight.

lines: Chàng trai năm xưa, giờ cũng đã thành một ông lão, đi qua con đường đó.
Ông ngồi xuống nghỉ dưới một tán cây.
scenes.image: An old man with a walking cane is sitting down to rest on a smooth stone under the shade of one of the big trees, wiping his forehead, looking up at the leaves above him.

lines: Một đứa bé chạy tới hỏi: "Ông ơi, ai trồng những cây này vậy?"
scenes.image: A small child has run up to the seated old man and is looking up at him, pointing at the tall trees, with a question mark in a small speech bubble above the child's head.

lines: Ông định trả lời, rồi chợt khựng lại.
Suốt bốn mươi năm, ông chưa từng hỏi tên người trồng cây.
scenes.image: Close view of the seated old man with his mouth half open, frozen mid-answer, a faded grey memory bubble above him showing the young kneeling figure he once laughed at.

lines: Rồi ông đi tìm một cái xẻng.
scenes.image: The old man has stood up and is walking away from the shaded road toward an empty sunlit stretch of ground, carrying a shovel over his shoulder, his cane left leaning against the tree behind him.
